expected_findings.root_cause: The HeadersType alias and Request.headers annotation are widened from Mapping[str, str | bytes] to Mapping[str, object], so the static check that header values are text or bytes before they reach the wire is removed.
expected_findings.failure_path: A caller passes headers={"X-Count": 3} or a list-valued header; the type checker accepts it and the non-string value reaches header preparation at runtime, where it is rejected (or serialized unexpectedly) instead of being caught at the API boundary.
